title: CHANGE OF OCCUPANCY OR USE
officialText:
R505.1 General. Any space that is converted to a dwelling unit or portion thereof from another
use or occupancy shall comply with Section R502.
Exception: Where the simulated building performance option in Section R405 is used to
comply with this section, the annual energy cost of the proposed design is permitted to be
110 percent of the annual energy cost allowed by Section R405.2.
R505.1.1 Unconditioned space. Any unconditioned or low-energy space that is altered to
become a conditioned space shall comply with Section R501.6.
